description: PHOENIX – Today, Gov. Katie Hobbs launched Native Americans for Katie, a coalition of Native leaders, community members, and elected officials working to re-elect her. Hobbs made history as the first Arizona governor to deliver an annual Tribal State of the State Address, and to visit all 22 federally recognized Tribal Nations in Arizona.
